title: LIFX Brightness Cap After Restore
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifx:state event=power_restore
| stats avg(brightness_pct) as avg_brightness_pct by bulb
| where avg_brightness_pct<70
| sort avg_brightness_pct
description: Uses LIFX power-restore events telemetry to monitor brightness level after power returns in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for bulbs coming back dimmer than users expect, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest LIFX power-restore events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Bulb table of average restore brightness.
grandmaExplanation: It turns brightness level after power returns so you can spot bulbs coming back dimmer than users expect before it becomes annoying.
